rows.Kwic: 君為正位，臣乃偏位，臣向君是偏中正，君視臣是正中偏，君臣道合

Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Eryin Mi (二隱謐禪師語錄): Eryin Mi explicitly introduces Caoshan Benji's formulation; Caoshan defines ruler as the upright position, minister as the inclined position, their mutual orientations, and their accord.

rows.Kwic: 豈不見釋迦陞座，文殊白椎，馬祖陞堂，百丈捲席

Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Eryin Mi (二隱謐禪師語錄): in Eryin Mi's address appointing officers, Shakyamuni Buddha is the exact actor who mounts the seat, paired with Manjusri's sounding the gavel; Eryin sets this beside Mazu mounting the hall and Baizhang rolling the mat.
